title: Manhattan, rising
description: Five landmark elevations grow from the baseline and change rank as dated skyline snapshots advance.
useCase: Show how a ranked illustrated comparison evolves across meaningful historical states.
reducedMotion: Buildings and rank positions update immediately for keyboard activation and reduced motion; pointer transitions grow from the baseline.
limitations: Five selected landmarks, not a complete Manhattan skyline or a construction-progress dataset. Rounded architectural heights; growth between snapshots is an illustrative transition, not measured construction speed.
look: Pale blue-grey page with five finely drawn skyscraper elevations as bars on a gridded baseline, rust monospace height labels above, and a segmented year control.
motion: Choosing a year re-sorts the towers by height in a 650 ms ease-out slide, scales newly built ones up from the baseline and collapses and fades unbuilt ones.
adapt: `order` sorts `BUILDINGS` by `builtHeight` for the chosen `year`; each `.sf-sort-building` slides via inline `translateX`, `.sf-sort-elevation` grows with `scaleY`, all on `650ms cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.24,1)`. Replace `BUILDINGS`, `YEARS` and the `OUTLINES` drawings with your own series.
